The '''Kamdon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talas]], as well as a [[Unidentified jungle world (Kamdon system)|jungle planet]].
